script_text: Aries, Mars squares Saturn this week, and fire energy demands you stop running from the hard stuff. Wednesday shifts everything when Venus enters your 5th House, igniting romance and creative confidence. Mars fires up your 10th House of career on Friday, so pitch that project you've been avoiding. The weekend brings lunar eclipse energy Sunday — rest, don't force anything. Tuesday is your power day because the Sun trines Jupiter in your 4th House, blessing your home and emotional foundation. Monday is your worst day because Mercury opposes Neptune, clouding judgment and inviting miscommunication. Let Mars in your 10th House drive your career moves this week, but check every email twice before sending. Follow for daily updates.
